avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces rufinamide plasma concentrations and seizure control efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; avoid concurrent use or select alternative herbal supplement

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May lower seizure threshold and counteract antiepileptic efficacy of rufinamide
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; counsel patient on seizure risk if discontinued abruptly

caution_supplements.name: Folate/Folic acid supplementation
caution_supplements.mechanism: Rufinamide may impair folate metabolism; supplementation recommended to prevent deficiency
caution_supplements.action: Monitor folate levels; consider folic acid 1mg daily or higher doses if deficiency documented

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Increases rufinamide absorption and peak plasma concentration; may alter seizure control consistency
caution_foods.action: Administer rufinamide consistently with or without food to maintain stable drug levels

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: CNS depression additive effect; may increase sedation and impair seizure threshold
caution_foods.action: Advise limiting alcohol intake; monitor for increased CNS effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor seizure frequency and breakthrough seizures if supplements or dietary patterns change. Assess folate and vitamin D status periodically as antiepileptics impair metabolism of these nutrients.
